root_findings: The individual-renderer captures are not isolated: approved body pieces and unrelated scene objects remain visible, and several target shapes are clipped outside the frame.
The Flight spiral proof contains Scene-view framing or overlay artifacts and does not provide a clean camera-space audit image.
Multiple gray-background fragment and spark proofs are effectively blank, so visibility and edge quality cannot be verified on both mandatory backgrounds.
Visible lobes and ripple spans read as oversized flat polygon sheets with layered alpha banding rather than authored volumetric energy forms.
The capture scale is inconsistent across roles and prevents a meaningful comparison of silhouette, falloff, depth, and body attachment.
The proof gate therefore fails before composite, timing, prefab completion, or lifecycle validation.

r3_binding_requirements.capture_isolation: Render only the selected derived renderer against a clean proof camera; no body, other VFX renderers, scene gizmos, labels, handles, overlays, or unrelated objects.
r3_binding_requirements.framing: Center the complete selected silhouette with consistent padding and no clipping on both black and neutral gray backgrounds.
r3_binding_requirements.visibility: Every individual role must remain visibly auditable on both backgrounds without becoming blank or merging into the backdrop.
r3_binding_requirements.shape_quality: Replace broad hard-edged polygon sheets and visible alpha stacking with restrained rounded falloff, layered depth, and role-specific silhouettes that still read at gameplay scale.
r3_binding_requirements.flight: Keep the approved body unobscured. The attached flight structure must be open, discontinuous, tapered, and visibly connected without reading as a complete ring, cage, flat ribbon, or detached bead trail.
r3_binding_requirements.stage_limit: Return only corrected individual black/gray proofs. Do not generate composite captures, implement the timeline, run lifecycle cycles, or claim prefab completion before a new Root proof decision.
